title: Posterior-centered contextual residual MGDA smoke
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: Replacing the generic-dominated raw interaction with a frozen calibrated six-style posterior and zero-mean learned head mixture will produce reproducible context-dependent policy behavior: both seeds retain the preservation/geometry contracts, conditioning heads update, and the median correct-context policy both remains nonnegative versus Standard10 and beats cyclically mismatched context.
material_change: Use the exact hash-frozen admitted 64-hand L2=1/temperature=1.1892 classifier. The trainable residual is a posterior-weighted mixture of six state-conditioned policy heads after subtracting the uniform posterior, structurally forbidding a shared generic delta; zero context and uniform posterior remain exact Standard10. Repeat the parent's two-seed 4,608 training-hand and 9,216 three-arm evaluation budget on new seeds.
baseline: The raw-interaction parent had contextual/generic logit ratios 16.0% and 8.25%, under 0.1% context action disagreement, and exactly zero correct-vs-wrong reward difference despite stable MGDA updates.
notes: This is an architecture-mechanism control at small scale. A clear failure to produce context-dependent actions rejects this formulation; noisy absolute reward alone will not be treated as asymptotic evidence.

Seed0 completed and its checkpoint plus raw training/evaluation/schedule evidence are preserved. Seed1 generated 2,304 environment training hands but failed before update because at least one opponent-seat group had fewer than 64 hero-decision rows; its in-memory rows were not persisted by the pre-recovery trainer. No artifact was overwritten.

Seed0's +3.115 bb/100 versus base and +19.568 bb/100 correct-versus-wrong are promising mechanism evidence only. They are not accepted as a two-seed result and will not be used for strength promotion.

result.summary: The posterior-centered architecture completed seed0 with genuine context dependence and 99.66% Standard10 agreement, then the run stopped safely at seed1's pre-update support gate. Only one of two seeds is complete, so the experiment is failed for infrastructure rather than scientific rejection.
result.conclusion: The zero-mean posterior head design repaired the parent's inactive-context symptom in seed0, but the planned two-seed test is incomplete. A brittle without-replacement group batch of 64 exceeded one seed's collected hero-decision support; the correct response is a fresh matched recovery with a lower fixed batch and earlier evidence persistence.
result.next_step: Persist each seed's raw training evidence before optimization, report exact per-group supports, and rerun two wholly new seeds with fixed group_batch_size=32 while preserving all other budgets and gates.
